findings.claim: The VDCI lesson describes legends as definitions of drawing symbols and conventions, and air-distribution plans as showing ductwork, diffusers and returns.

support.section: Legends Come First; M1 Series: Air Distribution Plans

findings.applicability: Supports including an explicit legend and system context in proposed examples. It does not define the full air-device class or prove that M1 sheet names identify eligible count views in every project.
findings.example_implication: Show an eligible plan symbol beside a separately identified legend example; owner adjudication must set the counting treatment.

findings.claim: The lesson describes enlarged plans as closer views of an area on a main floor plan, sections/isometrics as spatial views, schematics as logical relationships and details as instructions for particular conditions.

support.section: Enlarged Plans; Sections and Isometrics; Schematics; Details

findings.applicability: Supports preserving view purpose and explicit correspondence evidence in the example packet. A counting deduplication algorithm, physical-instance identity rule and automatic view-priority rule are absent.
findings.example_implication: Include one explicitly linked plan/enlarged depiction and another pair whose correspondence is unknown; do not let source titles or proximity decide physical identity.

findings.claim: The lesson describes schedules as tables of equipment/system information including tags, unit specifications, utilities and accessory requirements.
findings.applicability: Supports representing a schedule as attribute evidence in examples. The source does not say a repeated type tag is a unique physical instance, give an air-device size schema, or resolve count/size discrepancies between plans and schedules.
findings.example_implication: Include repeated plan type tags with one schedule type row, and a conflicting schedule case; owner adjudication must determine the count and unresolved state.

findings.claim: FastDUCT's product description presents each and linear feet as distinct selectable assembly units; it also describes reporting by item tags and color-coded overlays for plan changes.
findings.applicability: Primary evidence for advertised software features only. It does not establish how a continuous/slot diffuser becomes one each unit, a count conversion from dimensions/airflow, or work-status classification rules.
findings.example_implication: Include a linear device with explicit segment/unit identity and one without it; the missing counting basis remains an owner decision.

findings.claim: The selected Price and Titus resource entries returned success envelopes but empty indexed bodies; neither can support a mechanical requirement.
findings.applicability: Record missing content as unavailable evidence. Do not infer catalog, handbook or product requirements from the URL or manufacturer name.
findings.example_implication: Manufacturer-specific size and linear-device definitions remain unverified.
